prog.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            orbit = {
                (r, c), (r, n - 1 - c), (n - 1 - r, c), (n - 1 - r, n - 1 - c),
                (c, r), (c, n - 1 - r), (n - 1 - c, r), (n - 1 - c, n - 1 - r),
            }
            seen.update(orbit)
            values = [grid[i][j] for i, j in orbit if grid[i][j] != 2]
            if values:
                value = values[0]
                for i, j in orbit:
                    if grid[i][j] == 2:
                        out[i][j] = value
    return out
'''
path=prog/'task-261cccde.py'
path.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(compile(code,str(path),'exec'),ns)
out=ns['transform'](grid)
print('2s left',sum(x==2 for row in out for x in row), 'dimensions',len(out),len(out[0]))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
